difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces that is locally of finite presentation, flat and surjective with X regular, the lemma concludes that Y is regular (statement lines 5306-5311). The proof names the algebraic statement it reduces to -- a faithfully flat finitely presented ring homomorphism A -> B with B Noetherian and regular forces A to be Noetherian and regular -- and then establishes the two conclusions separately with the descent lemmas for Noetherianness and for regularity under flat maps (proof lines 5313-5320). The level is H2: the reduction and both halves of the algebra statement are displayed, each with its input named.
